dashboard_wallboard.no_panels: No panels are defined on this dashboard yet.

signin.subtitle: Sign in to your workspace
signin.forgot_subtitle: Enter your account email and we’ll send you a password reset link.
signin.forgot_privacy_hint: To protect your account, we show the same result whether or not the email exists.
signin.forgot_sent_subtitle: If {{email}} belongs to an active account, a reset link will arrive shortly.
signin.forgot_sent_detail: The link expires in 30 minutes and can only be used once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
signin.reset_subtitle: Set a new sign-in password for your MoleSignal account.
signin.reset_success: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
signin.reset_invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new one.

link.title: Confirm it’s your account
link.subtitle: {{email}} already has a MoleSignal account. Confirm it’s yours, and {{provider}} ({{organization}}) will sign you in to it from now on.
link.code_target: We’ll email a 6-digit code to this address.
link.unavailable: This account has no password and this instance can’t send email, so it can’t be confirmed here. Sign in the way you did before, or ask an administrator to set up email.

signin.password_subtitle: Enter the password for this account.
signin.passkey_wrong_address: This address isn’t the instance’s external URL, so passkeys don’t work here.
signin.passkey_unknown: This passkey is no longer registered here. Sign in with your password.

mfa.title: Verify it’s you
mfa.subtitle_totp: This account uses multi-factor authentication. Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for MoleSignal.
mfa.subtitle_recovery: Enter a recovery code you haven’t used yet. Each code works once.
mfa.subtitle_passkey: This account uses multi-factor authentication. Verify it’s you with your passkey.
mfa.expired: This sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.
mfa.recovery_none_left: That was your last recovery code. Make new ones under Account settings → Security.
mfa.locked: Too many wrong codes. Signing in is locked for a while; try again later.

enroll.title: Turn on multi-factor authentication
enroll.subtitle: “{{organization}}” asks for multi-factor authentication. Pick a way to verify, then carry on signing in.
enroll.totp_hint: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key in by hand, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
enroll.qr_alt: QR code for an authenticator app
enroll.passkey_hint: Press the button below and follow your browser’s prompt to create a passkey. It can be kept in iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager or a security key.
enroll.finish_passkey: Create a passkey and sign in
enroll.expired: This sign-in has expired. Sign in again.

signin.sso_only: Your workspace only allows single sign-on. Sign in with a provider below.
signin.limited_minutes_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
signin.limited_minutes_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
signin.limited_seconds_one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
signin.limited_seconds_other: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
signin.limited_hint: You can also reset your password.
signin.limited_hint_passkey: You can also sign in with a passkey or reset your password.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Enter your email to get started.
signup.details_subtitle: Add a name and a password for this address.
signup.pending_desc: Your account is awaiting administrator approval.
signup.signin_required_desc: This workspace asks for multi-factor authentication: sign in and follow the steps to turn it on.
signup.check_email_subtitle: We’re sending a message to {{email}}. Follow it to carry on.
signup.check_email_detail: A link in it lasts 30 minutes and works once. Check your spam folder if nothing arrives.
signup.link_expired_subtitle: Links last 30 minutes and work once. Start again to get a new one.

unsupported.title: Molesignal is built for wide screens
unsupported.body: This console is designed for desktop SRE workflows and needs at least 1024px of width. Switch to a wider display or maximize your window.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: An observability platform for logs, metrics, traces, and performance analysis.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.

route_error.title: This page ran into a problem
route_error.description: Something failed while drawing it. Other pages are not affected.
route_error.stale_description: This page was updated while you had it open. Reload to get the new version.

access_denied.title: You don't have access to this page
access_denied.description: Your role ({{role}}) can't open {{page}}. An organization administrator can grant it.
access_denied.go_on: Go to a page you can open
access_denied.request_text: Please grant me access to {{page}} in MoleSignal ({{path}}). My current role is {{role}}.
